title: Squeeze the brown gas
hook: Squeeze a brown gas and it goes darker. Then it fights back.

knows: that an equilibrium runs both ways at once
that squeezing a gas raises its pressure
doesNotKnow: that a squeeze shifts an equilibrium toward the side with fewer gas molecules

misconception: When you disturb an equilibrium nothing sensible happens, or it always shifts toward products.
objective: The learner can explain that halving the volume of an N₂O₄/NO₂ mixture lowers the share of NO₂ (about 31% to 24% here), because two NO₂ pair into one N₂O₄ and fewer molecules partly undo the squeeze.

claims.text: N₂O₄ is colourless and NO₂ is brown, and the two are in equilibrium: N₂O₄ ⇌ 2 NO₂.
claims.source: Brown et al., Chemistry: The Central Science, ch. 15 (the N₂O₄/NO₂ equilibrium); Greenwood & Earnshaw, Chemistry of the Elements, ch. 11.

claims.text: At 25 °C the equilibrium constant Kp is about 0.15 bar.
claims.source: Kp = exp(−ΔG°/RT), ΔG° = 2 ΔfG°(NO₂) − ΔfG°(N₂O₄) = 2(51.31) − 97.89 = 4.73 kJ/mol (NBS/NIST tables via Atkins, Physical Chemistry, data section) → Kp = 0.148 at 298 K. Kc = Kp/RT = 0.00597 mol/L.

claims.text: Halving the volume lowers the NO₂ share of molecules from about 31% to about 24%.
claims.source: Ideal gas, 298 K, starting at about 1 bar total (0.0340 mol/L N₂O₄ before splitting). Solve Kc = 4a²c/(1 − a): a = 0.189 at c, 0.138 at 2c; share 2a/(1+a) = 32% → 24%. Stage rounds to 60 N₂O₄ units: 22 NO₂ + 49 N₂O₄ (31%) → 16 + 52 (24%). Node script.

claims.text: Right after the squeeze the gas is darker at once, then fades part way back but stays darker than at the start.
claims.source: Brownness follows NO₂ per volume: 22/V before, 44/V the instant after halving, 32/V at the new equilibrium (same model as c3).

claims.text: Squeezed, the mixture shifts toward the side with fewer gas molecules and only partly undoes the squeeze.
claims.source: Le Chatelier's principle for pressure changes (Atkins, Physical Chemistry, 'response of equilibria to pressure'; Brown et al. ch. 15).

claims.text: Stage: the plunger halves the volume at constant 25 °C; dot positions come from a seeded generator (seed 4, untuned, positions only).
claims.source: Demo.tsx. Real compression warms a gas; the model holds temperature fixed.

recall.question: For N₂ + 3 H₂ ⇌ 2 NH₃, you halve the volume. The share of NH₃ at the new equilibrium is…
recall.why: Four gas molecules become two, so a squeeze shifts toward NH₃, the side with fewer molecules.
